prose: OpenAI has secured about $11 billion in commitments for its latest funding round - less than half of its initial $30 billion target - and expects to raise more in the coming weeks, the Wall Street Journal reports via sources; the round values the ChatGPT maker at $1.25 trillion, below the $1.4 trillion it had targeted. The article is paywalled to the fetcher (HTTP 401), so the figures come from the feed's report.
highlights: OpenAI secures ~$11B in commitments, less than half its $30B target
Round values it at $1.25T, below the $1.4T target; more expected in coming weeks
